name: @kairo/desktop
description: Kairo IDE — desktop entry. Electron shell + Theia frontend + in-process Go Runtime Agent.

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/build-agent.js && node scripts/copy-browser-artifacts.js && node scripts/copy-bundled.js
scripts.build:win: pnpm --filter @kairo/browser build && pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../../scripts/prepare-bundled.ps1 -Strict -BundledRoot apps/desktop/bundled && node scripts/build-agent.js && node scripts/copy-browser-artifacts.js --strict && tsc -p tsconfig.json && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:win:release: pnpm --filter @kairo/browser build && pwsh -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../../scripts/prepare-bundled.ps1 -Strict -BundledRoot apps/desktop/bundled && node scripts/build-agent.js && node scripts/copy-browser-artifacts.js --strict && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pwsh -Command "$env:KAIRO_REQUIRE_SIGNING='1'; electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml"
scripts.test: node --require ts-node/register --require source-map-support/register --test src/process-manager.test.ts src/child-lifecycle.test.ts src/theia-port-discover.test.ts src/agent-state.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: node --require ts-node/register --require source-map-support/register --test src/process-manager.test.ts src/child-lifecycle.test.ts src/theia-port-discover.test.ts src/agent-state.test.ts
